visual_brief.subject: A security-remediation agent that must pass an external CodeQL check before handing a patch to human review
verified_context: GitHub's Agentic Autofix explores relevant repository files, proposes a repair, and reruns CodeQL before opening a draft pull request.
The CodeQL rerun cannot confirm fixes for custom queries, the security-extended query suite, or alerts from third-party scanners.
GitHub requires teams to review and test the generated changes before merge.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Autonomous repair becomes more trustworthy when the proposed fix must pass through a verifier outside the agent before it reaches the human merge boundary.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A terracotta repair piece travels from a deep workshop into a separate layered inspection chamber, then rests in an open review tray that is visibly not a final locked gate.

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant. The full workshop-to-inspection-to-review sequence is clear, but the human figure and broad chamber make the repair artifact less dominant at thumbnail size.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant. The sculptural aperture is strong, but the generic puzzle-piece silhouette and prominent hands reduce continuity with the architectural golden references.
candidate_notes.C: Selected. The rough workshop, independent layered inspection chamber, and open review tray create the clearest three-stage boundary while remaining tactile rather than diagrammatic. Faint paper strokes are non-linguistic texture; no legible characters are present.

crop_review.article_desktop: The wide crop retains the rough workshop, central inspection chamber, and open review tray as one left-to-right sequence.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered narrow crop keeps the layered inspection chamber and repair piece as the primary verifier relationship.
crop_review.thumbnail: Terracotta repair forms, the bright layered chamber, and the open tray remain distinct at 320px wide.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected image shares the references' warm paper field, dark containment mass, terracotta working object, controlled perspective, tactile materiality, and strong single boundary relationship while adding a new repair-and-review sequence.
